info.name: spectrograph_ar
info.description: Continuous fibrous plasma stream that maps the live frequency spectrum to color bands across its cross-section — magenta (sub-bass) through purple, blue, cyan, to green (highs). Domain-warped directional FBM noise creates organic striation and turbulence. Each color band's brightness is driven by its actual audio energy. Includes a hot white-magenta core pulse on bass hits, filament edge highlights, and a soft bloom haze.
